**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** June 6, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for continuous glucose monitoring has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**Diagnosis Requirement:** Met. Patient has an active diagnosis of Type 1 diabetes mellitus (E10.9), established May 22, 2023.

**Treatment Requirement:** Met. Patient is currently on insulin therapy—insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime, initiated August 12, 2024.

**Recent Evaluation Requirement:** Met. A telehealth diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. J. Holm occurred on April 6, 2025 (within 6 months of order date). The visit note by Dr. K. O'Neill documents review of glucose log and HbA1c, assessment of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, and discussion of continuous glucose monitoring.

All medical necessity criteria have been satisfied. The patient is eligible for continuous glucose monitoring.

*This authorization is valid for the service ordered on the date specified above.*
